title: Shared tree across LP2-32 and the 2016 message
question: Do the LP2-32 and 2016 tree renderings align with the already identified tree source under bounded scale, translation and orientation comparisons?
summary: LP2-55 and LP2-32 align more strongly in the same orientation; the Commons photograph and 2016 message align more strongly after reflection. Both use separate response rules and lower-region checks.

family.title: Shared dead-tree artwork source

scope.representation: Original LP2-32 and LP2-55 JPEGs; original Commons DeadTree.jpg and archived 2016 message JPEG; two declared grayscale-response comparisons.
scope.procedure: For each source-target pair, search specified scales and every in-crop integer translation in two orientations; maximize normalized correlation over the full crop or upper 60%, then score the lower 40% without refitting.
scope.parameters: LP2-55→LP2-32 crops [600,1450,1800,2500] and [550,2000,1850,3500], darkness levels 250/45 and 230/160, sigma 15, 24 scales 0.650–1.225. Commons→2016 crops [100,500,1750,1950] and [145,270,425,475], source darkness 170/130, message lightness 2/28 with pixels >100 masked, sigma 1.5, 26 scales 0.065–0.140.
scope.exclusions: Other source photographs and processing choices; rotation, shear, warps, exact authoring recipe; any cipher, rune or decryption operation; a calibrated chance probability.

finding: LP2-55→LP2-32 whole-region correlation is 0.623 same orientation versus 0.483 reflected; lower-region checks after upper fits are 0.600 versus 0.353. Commons→2016 whole-region correlation is 0.854 reflected versus 0.566 original; lower-region checks are 0.858 versus 0.442.
limitations: The sources, crops, contrast mappings and scale ranges were chosen after viewing the images. Lower-region checks are within the same selected carriers, not blind holdouts. Correlations are descriptive and do not recover the compositing process or probability against unrelated trees.
next_steps: Freeze a broader decoy set of unrelated tree photographs and apply the same selection budget; reconstruct intermediate tonal and branch-removal operations separately if source-processing history is sought.

reproduction.environment: Python 3 with NumPy and OpenCV; recorded with OpenCV 5.0.0. The experiment ZIP includes the Commons source but omits the three JPEGs under images/; extract original-images.zip or download them at their declared paths. No network or AI is used by the checker.

review.reviewer: Codex; numeric replay, original-file hashes and visual overlay inspection; independent photographic review pending
